exact_zero_characterization: All64andonly64classes have alternate=complement(reference_center), outerleft=complement(outerright), and innerleft=complement(innerright). Equivalently the mutant5mer equals the reverse complement of the reference5mer. The GCnumerator and canonical3mer spectrum are unchanged.
limits: Slots count every pre-existing assay-panel record. Duplicate or RC-identical sequences are not deduplicated and no genomic-unique count is claimed.

Exact feature equality forces equal outputs only for deterministic predictors using solely this feature vector. No measured functional effect, clinical consequence or biological neutrality is inferred.
Only interior single-nucleotide substitutions are enumerated. Boundary positions, indels, multi-edit haplotypes, positional or longer-context features are outside this scan.
Reported quantiles describe this fixed sequence panel; they are not inferential intervals.
purpose: Outcome-free exact feature equivalence scan, not a biological neutrality test.
